label: Season
description:
Respiratory virus season which starts on Morbidity Mortality Weekly Report (MMWR) week 26 and ends on week 27.  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
Values: Text (Season Years)

label: Age Group
description:
Includes age groups including <18 years (only for vaccine coverage and pediatric deaths),  <5 years,  5-17 years, 18-64 years for adults, and >64 years.  
                                                                                                                                                                                                            
Values: Text (Age groups)

label: RPHO Region
description:
Regional Public Health Office Region. Includes Bay Area, Central California, Greater Sierra-Sacramento, Los Angeles, Rural North, and Southern Callifornia. Also, includes the full state under the "California" region.

Values: Text (Region names)

label: Weekending Dates
description:
The date of the end of the CDC's Morbidity and Mortality Weekly Report (MMWR week). The start of the MMWR week is Sunday and the week ends on Saturday. 

Values: Dates in MM/DD/YYYY

label: MMWR Week
description:
Week number according to the MMWR, starting with 1 for the first full week of the year.

Values: Positive Numeric

label: MMWR Year
description:
Year corresponding to the MMWR week.

Values: Positive Numeric

label: Vaccine Coverage for COVID-19
description:
Modelled Vaccine Coverage Estimates for COVID-19. Modelled value provided for California, but range provided for other regions.

Values: Positive Numeric and categorical ranges

label: Vaccine Coverage for Influenza
description:
Modelled Vaccine Coverage Estimates for Influenza. Modelled value provided for California, but range provided for other regions.

Values: Positive Numeric and categorical ranges

label: Weekly Vaccine Doses for COVID-19
description:
Number of  Vaccine Doses for COVID-19 by MMWR week.

Values: Positive Numeric

label: Weekly Vaccine Doses for Influenza
description:
Number of  Vaccine Doses for Influenza by MMWR week.

Values: Positive Numeric

label: Season Cumulative Vaccine Doses for COVID-19
description:
Cumulative Vaccine Doses for COVID-19, resetting to 0 when a new vaccine product is available.

Values: Positive Numeric

label: Season Cumulative Vaccine Doses for Influenza
description:
Cumulative Vaccine Doses for Influenza by standard season.

Values: Positive Numeric

label: Positive COVID-19 Tests
description:
Number of laboratory COVID-19 positive test results for each MMWR week.

Values: Positive Numeric

label: Total Number of COVID-19 Tests
description:
Total number of COVID-19 tests each MMWR week.

Values: Positive Numeric

label: Percentage of COVID-19 Positive Tests
description:
COVID-19 test positivity percentage.

The percent of COVID-19 positive tests divided by the total number of tests each MMWR week.
Numerator: Number of laboratory COVID-19 positive test results for each MMWR week.
Denominator:  Total number of COVID-19 tests each MMWR week.

Values: Positive Numeric

label: COVID-19 Test Positivity Level
description:
Level of COVID-19 test-positivity based on 5 prior seasons of test-positivity data. With <2%  for "Very Low", 2-7%  for "Low", 7-11%  for "Moderate", 11-16%  for "High", and >16% for "Very Low" for all ages. See Data Notes on Respiratory Virus Dashboard for age levels.

Values: Text (Level name)

label: Positive Influenza Tests
description:
Number of influenza laboratory positive test results for each MMWR week.

Values: Positive Numeric

label: Total Number of Influenza Tests
description:
Total number of influenza tests each MMWR week.

Values: Positive Numeric

label: Percentage of Influenza Positive Tests
description:
Influenza test positivity percentage.

The percent of influenza positive tests divided by the total number of tests each MMWR week.
Numerator: Number of laboratory influenza positive test results for each MMWR week.
Denominator:  Total number of influenza tests each MMWR week.

Values: Positive Numeric

label: Influenza Test Positivity Level
description:
Level of influenza test-positivity based on 5 prior seasons of test-positivity data. With <2%  for "Very Low", 2-5%  for "Low", 5-9%  for "Moderate", 9-13%  for "High", and >13% for "Very Low" for all ages. See Data Notes on Respiratory Virus Dashboard for age levels.

Values: Text (Level name)

label: Positive RSV Tests
description:
Number of RSV laboratory positive test results for each MMWR week.

Values: Positive Numeric

label: Total Number of RSV Tests
description:
Total number of RSV tests each MMWR week.

Values: Positive Numeric

label: Percentage of RSV Positive Tests
description:
RSV test positivity percentage.

The percent of RSV positive tests divided by the total number of tests each MMWR week.
Numerator: Number of laboratory RSV positive test results for each MMWR week.
Denominator:  Total number of RSV tests each MMWR week.

Values: Positive Numeric

label: RSV Test Positivity Level
description:
Level of RSV test-positivity based on 5 prior seasons of test-positivity data. With <1%  for "Very Low", 1-4%  for "Low", 4-6%  for "Moderate", 6-9%  for "High", and >9% for "Very Low" for all ages. See Data Notes on Respiratory Virus Dashboard for age levels.

Values: Text (Level name)

label: Total Positive Flu A Tests
description:
Total number of influenza A tests each MMWR week.

Values: Positive Numeric

label: Total Positive Flu B Tests
description:
Total number of influenza B tests each MMWR week.

Values: Text (Level name)

label: Percentage of COVID-19 Emergency Department Visits
description:
The percentage of COVID-19 emergency department (ED) visits. Only available for the age group "All Ages" and the region "California".      

Numerator: The number of ED visits with symptoms attributed to COVID-19 for that week
Denominator:  The total number of ED visits for that week

Values: Positive Numeric

label: Percentage of Influenza Emergency Department Visits
description:
The percentage of influenza ED visits. Only available for the age group "All Ages" and the region "California".  

Numerator: The number of ED visits with symptoms attributed to influenza for that week
Denominator:  The total number of ED visits for that week

Values: Positive Numeric

label: Percentage of RSV Emergency Department Visits
description:
The percentage of RSV ED visits. Only available for the age group "All Ages" and the region "California".  

Numerator: The number of ED visits with symptoms attributed to RSV for that week
Denominator:  The total number of ED visits for that week

Values: Positive Numeric

label: Population
description:
Population determined by State of California Department of Finance P-3 Complete State and County Projections Dataset. Reported weekly admission rates for the entire season use the population estimates for the year the season started.

Values: Positive Numeric

label: COVID-19 Hospital Admissions
description:
Number of new COVID-19-associated hospital admissions in the National Healthcare Safety Network (NHSN). As COVID-19 hospitalization data reporting was required by age and in total prior to May 2024, we show hospitalization data for COVID-19 for all three seasons and have imputed modeled data from May-October 2024.

Values: Positive Numeric

label: Influenza Hospital Admissions
description:
Number of new influenza-associated hospital admissions in NHSN. The requirement to report COVID-19, influenza, and RSV-associated hospitalizations was effective November 1, 2024, therefore we only show hospitalization data by age and in total for influenza and RSV data after November 1, 2024.

Values: Positive Numeric

label: RSV Hospital Admissions
description:
Number of new RSV-associated hospital admissions in NHSN

Values: Positive Numeric

label: Weekly Rate of COVID-19 Hospital Admissions
description:
The weekly rate of COVID-19-associated hospital admissions in California reported to the CDC's NHSN data.  The requirement to report COVID-19, influenza, and RSV-associated hospitalizations was effective November 1, 2024, therefore we only show hospitalization data by age and in total for influenza and RSV data after November 1, 2024.
Numerator: Number of new COVID-19-associated hospital admissions in NHSN
Denominator:  Population determined by State of California Department of Finance P-3 Complete State and County Projections Dataset. Reported weekly admission rates for the entire season use the population estimates for the year the season started.

Values: Positive Numeric

label: Weekly Rate of Influenza Hospital Admissions
description:
The weekly rate of influenza-associated hospital admissions in California reported to the CDC's NHSN data. The requirement to report COVID-19, influenza, and RSV-associated hospitalizations was effective November 1, 2024, therefore we only show hospitalization data by age and in total for influenza and RSV data after November 1, 2024.  
Numerator: Number of new influenza-associated hospital admissions in NHSN
Denominator:  Population determined by State of California Department of Finance P-3 Complete State and County Projections Dataset. Reported weekly admission rates for the entire season use the population estimates for the year the season started.

Values: Positive Numeric

label: Weekly Rate of RSV Hospital Admissions
description:
The weekly rate of RSV-associated hospital admissions in California reported to the CDC's NHSN data. The requirement to report COVID-19, influenza, and RSV-associated hospitalizations was effective November 1, 2024, therefore we only show hospitalization data by age and in total for influenza and RSV data after November 1, 2024.  
Numerator: Number of new RSV-associated hospital admissions in NHSN
Denominator:  Population determined by State of California Department of Finance P-3 Complete State and County Projections Dataset. Reported weekly admission rates for the entire season use the population estimates for the year the season started.

Values: Positive Numeric

label: COVID-19 Admission Level
description:
Level of COVID-19 admissions based on 5 prior seasons of test-positivity data. With <2  for "Very Low", 2-11  for "Low",  11-20  for "Moderate", 20-28  for "High", and >28 for "Very Low" for all ages. See Data Notes on Respiratory Virus Dashboard for age levels.

Values: Text (Level name)

label: Influenza Admission Level
description:
Level of influenza admissions based on 5 prior seasons of test-positivity data. With <1  for "Very Low", 1-4  for "Low", 4-7  for "Moderate", 7-9  for "High", and >9 for "Very Low" for all ages. See Data Notes on Respiratory Virus Dashboard for age levels.

Values: Text (Level name)

label: RSV Admission Level
description:
Level of RSV admissions based on 5 prior seasons of test-positivity data. With <0.6  for "Very Low", 0.6-1.1  for "Low", 1.1-1.6  for "Moderate",  1.6-2.1  for "High", and >2.1 for "Very Low" for all ages. See Data Notes on Respiratory Virus Dashboard for age levels.

Values: Text (Level name)
